site.name: ECV Base
site.description: The directory of electric commercial vehicles and machines for Europe: specs, prices and manufacturer contacts for vans, trucks, buses, municipal, construction, agricultural and industrial machines.

search.label: Search vehicles
search.noMatches: No matches. Try a brand, a model or a job like “street cleaning”.

home.title: Find the right electric vehicle for the job
home.lead: Compare electric vans, trucks, buses and machines for municipal, construction, farming and industrial use. Specs from manufacturer sources, and a direct line to the people who sell them.
home.searchHint: e.g. electric street sweeper, 7.5 t truck, mini excavator
home.byTypeLead: From cargo bikes to 44 t tractor units.
home.byJobLead: Start from what the vehicle has to do.
home.recentLead: The latest additions and changes to the directory.
home.guidesLead: Independent explanations to help you compare.
home.trust1: Every model in the same format, units spelled out, sources linked.
home.trust2: Every model is listed free. Paid visibility is always labelled.
home.trust3: Email the manufacturer directly. No forms, no lead reselling.
home.manufacturersTitle: Are you a manufacturer or importer?
home.manufacturersLead: Put a named contact and confirmed data behind every model.
